claims.content: The C2 JU publishes electronic warfare surveillance products by determining eligible EW detections and transmitting lines of bearing (LOBs), areas of probability (AOPs), or fixes via the J3.7 EW Product Information message on the Surveillance Network PG.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU publishes electronic warfare surveillance products by determining eligible EW detections and transmitting lines of bearing (LOBs), areas of probability (AOPs), or fixes via the J3.7 EW Product Information message on the Surveillance Network PG.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU must be EW-capable or capable of generating and managing track numbers.
The C2 JU must participate in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages on the Link 16 network.
The C2 JU determines which electronic warfare (EW) detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU determines which electronic warfare (EW) detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, either manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.
The C2 JU transmits Lines of Bearing (LOBs), Areas of Probability (AOPs), or fixes derived from EW detections using the J3.7 EW Product Information message on the Surveillance Network PG.

When reporting an AOP, the C2 JU assigns a new Track Number (TN) if the AOP results from previously reported LOBs or from two or more fixes of differing TNs; however, if a fix is changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix is used.
The C2 JU includes time data in the J3.7I word indicating when the EW product information was valid, expressed in hours, minutes, and seconds.

The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met; the JU shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message to cease reporting, after which the information may be purged in accordance with system design.
The C2 JU has transmitted Lines of Bearing (LOBs), Areas of Probability (AOPs), or fixes derived from EW detections using the J3.7 EW Product Information message on the Surveillance Network PG.

If an Area of Probability (AOP) results from previously reported LOBs or from two or more fixes of differing Track Numbers (TNs), a new TN is assigned; however, if a fix is changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix is used.
The unit originating the J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report retains reporting responsibility.
The J3.7I word includes time data indicating when the EW product information was valid.
If the transmission of EW product information is terminated because the information is no longer valid or update requirements are not met, the JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
